stages.title: Story: chapters 1-4 and the finale
stages.why: Play the campaign start to finish first. Every chapter and mission trophy lands on the critical path, so nothing here needs a detour; the one decision that matters is the manual save before the final mission, which keeps free roam and clean-up open. Two of the hidden trophies are choice-driven story beats, so save before big decisions.

stages.title: Strangers and freaks
stages.why: Once each district is open, chains of stranger jobs appear. A strand counts only when its final mission is done, and a few characters go quiet once the story moves on, so clear each chain you start. Eight strands give the silver; Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret each carry a trophy of their own.

stages.title: Activities and collectibles
stages.why: The long tail: 250 stunts, 42 shooting-range golds, every Top Fun venue, 20 different race wins, meditation spots, 100 WAiNK locations, 3 card sets, 100 vehicles, the whole map explored and 50 challenges. Work district by district and tick counters as they move, because the in-game stats lag behind what you think you did.

stages.title: Partner and crime set-pieces
stages.why: These need your partner present or a specific heat state, so do them back to back in one session: the 4-star escape, three shops without dropping the wanted level, five vaults, the armored truck, the silent jewelry job, one illegal operation per gang, Combat Focus kills and the melee drive-by.

stages.title: Money, property and world secrets
stages.why: Fund the garage purchases and shop spend with laundering and heists, then mop up the scene-flavoured hidden trophies (VCIA departure, the Rhino, Ocean Beach, the showroom exit, the bowling alley, the second-attempt and secret-event ones) while the world is quiet.

stages.title: Platinum cleanup
stages.why: Check the in-game completion percentage against this checklist, finish whatever category is short, and the 100% gold plus the platinum fall together.
